notes: «الخصال» is cited by title only (al-Saduq's book); its own chain is not in the text, which gives only «عن علي عليه السلام»: a source known only by a title, so the ruling is needed
«[-/1]» is the editor's numbering and is left out
«علي» is written inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator, not an Imam in text
